assets.name: Water Tower
assets.scale_status: Proposed game-art dimensions, not measured CAD. Main body width/depth exclude attached stairs, balconies and eaves; total height includes roof/tower. Placement envelope is a blockout allowance for attachments, not a gameplay clearance or building code.
assets.silhouette: Coral cylindrical tank with teal conical cap on four timber supports.
assets.roof_and_height: Maintenance platform around Z=4.4 m; tank base 4.7 m; tank top 6.9 m; roof cap top 8.0 m. Tank diameter 3.4 m.
assets.opening_schedule: One rear access ladder, one right-side discharge pipe; no front ladder.
assets.construction_notes: Exactly four main legs at corners of a 3.4 m square. Splay feet slightly outward within 4 m footprint. Keep braces behind the ladder. Add a maintenance platform gate where ladder meets it.
assets.view_resolution: The hero appears to show a front-side ladder while the REAR view shows rear access. Use one rear ladder only, following the written layout. Render scale is squat; use the proposed height if a tall landmark is desired.
assets.pivot: At ground level, horizontally centered on the FRONT main-wall baseline. Main body occupies X=-width/2..+width/2 and Y=0..depth; front attachments extend into negative Y.
assets.coordinates: Meters, +X right in front view, +Y into building from front facade, +Z up.
assets.variant_rules: Keep openings and overall scale consistent. Swap predefined paint regions, shutters, roof accents and optional lamps. Mirror only when balcony/stair access and roof attachments are also resolved.

assets.name: Village Hall
assets.scale_status: Proposed game-art dimensions, not measured CAD. Main body width/depth exclude attached stairs, balconies and eaves; total height includes roof/tower. Placement envelope is a blockout allowance for attachments, not a gameplay clearance or building code.
assets.silhouette: Mustard village hall with a teal roof and integrated clock tower.
assets.roof_and_height: Main gable ridge runs across X, eave about 3.4 m, ridge 4.8 m. Centered front tower rises to 7.5 m including pyramidal cap.
assets.opening_schedule: Front: central double door, one broad window per wing. Each side: two windows. Rear: service door centered and two flanking windows.
assets.construction_notes: Tower width 2.4 m and projection 0.8 m beyond main front wall. Main roof ridge runs left-to-right; tower joins it without floating gaps. Clock uses four marks and separate hands.
assets.view_resolution: Tower height relative to hall varies between views. Use the written 7.5 m top height and retain the main roof at 4.8 m. No need to add detailed clock mechanism.
assets.pivot: At ground level, horizontally centered on the FRONT main-wall baseline. Main body occupies X=-width/2..+width/2 and Y=0..depth; front attachments extend into negative Y.
assets.coordinates: Meters, +X right in front view, +Y into building from front facade, +Z up.
assets.variant_rules: Keep openings and overall scale consistent. Swap predefined paint regions, shutters, roof accents and optional lamps. Mirror only when balcony/stair access and roof attachments are also resolved.
